purpose: Teach: 三国志/ハンマー/バイキング/スターウォーズ/カーニバル/肺炎/領事館/赤ワイン

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが三国志のご本を読んでらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's reading a book about the Three Kingdoms right now.
lines.style: Warm, observational tone. Gentle delivery with a slight lift toward Sho. Speaking as if sharing something she's noticed — not performing, just relaying.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとハンマーで本棚直してみたい
lines.en: Mom, I want to fix the bookshelf with Dad and a hammer.
lines.style: Small voice, genuine curiosity lighting it up. A hopeful lilt at the end — not demanding, but testing if it's a possible thing. Natural childhood earnestness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとバイキング形式の朝食を頂きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's have a buffet breakfast with Dad, shall we?
lines.style: Warm invitation, gently offering. Soft smile in the voice — the tone of including him in something pleasant she's thought of. Unhurried pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとスターウォーズの映画を観たいよ
lines.en: Mom, I really want to watch Star Wars with Dad.
lines.style: Small insistent note underneath — something he wants badly enough to ask again. Earnest but not whiny. Natural childhood persistence, genuine desire driving it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと地域のカーニバルに行きましょう
lines.en: Sho, let's go to the local carnival with Dad, won't we?
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, almost dreamy in its delivery. Soft, inviting. The tone of someone offering him something she thinks he'll like without pressure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんが肺炎で入院したお話、覚えてる
lines.en: Mom, do you remember when Grandpa was in the hospital with pneumonia?
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful. A child working through something real that's been sitting with him. Not seeking comfort yet — just checking if she holds the same memory. Vulnerable but steady.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが領事館で旅行ビザを受け取ってこられたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad picked up our travel visas from the consulate.
lines.style: Clear, informative but warm. A matter-of-fact statement delivered with quiet satisfaction — something accomplished, something moving forward. Composed but not distant.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんが赤ワインを召し上がってらしたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa was drinking red wine.
lines.style: Small, matter-of-fact observation. The tone of a child noticing and reporting something he's registered. Gentle, not alarmed — just stating what he saw.
